note: What a server sends to say a unit is swinging at another. The header names the unit acting.

fields.name: targetX
fields.note: Where the unit swung at stands, along one ground axis. Sent in world units, a client threw the swing at the unit named above.

fields.name: targetZ
fields.note: Where it stands, along the other ground axis.

fields.name: timing
fields.note: How the swing sits against the unit's own rhythm. 128 in everything observed.

fields.name: missile
fields.note: The name the missile this swing throws will answer to.

fields.name: slot
fields.note: Which of the unit's attacks this is. 64 in everything observed.
